meta.how: subagent 讀 SKILL.md、用 ai_api.py 查

answers.pucker-effect-name: LiveEffect name "Adobe Punk and Bloat"; the amount key is d_factor (real, default 0.0): <LiveEffect name="Adobe Punk and Bloat"><Dict data="R d_factor 0.0 "/></LiveEffect>
answers.zigzag-effect-keys: LiveEffect name "Adobe Zigzag"; ridges per segment is the key ridges (R ridges 4.0). Full defaults: R amount 10.0 R ridges 4.0 R absoluteness 1.0 R roundness 0.0 R relAmount 10.0.
answers.blocked-menu-cmds: File > Save Selected Slices (`Adobe AI Save Selected Slices`: the legacy Save for Web 'Save Optimized As' dialog re-opens itself after every answer; use Export for Screens / AI.png instead) and File > Print (`Print`: document.print(PrintOptions) never returns, timed out after 180 s three times; use AI.pdf()/AI.png()).
answers.repeat-config-null: The radialConfig / gridConfig / symmetryConfig getters return/throw a "NULL pointer" error in 28.0 (unusable). The skill sets Repeat options through Object > Repeat > Options instead, answering that dialog with a run_js dialog plan (e.g. dialog=["sel", "type:30", "tab", "ok"]).
answers.press-quality-bleed: PDF presets such as [Press Quality] reset the document bleed to 0 in the saved PDF. To keep the bleed, leave pDFPreset unset and set pDFXStandard = PDFXStandard.PDFX1A2001 plus trimMarks = true (bleed kept, verified via the PDF's BleedBox). DocumentPreset.documentBleedOffset sets the document bleed.
answers.tweak-effect-name: "Adobe Scribble and Tweak" (defaults: B in 1 R vert 10.0 R horz 10.0 B anch 1 B out 1 R aver 10.0 R ahor 10.0 R absoluteness 0.0).
answers.twist-effect-name: LiveEffect name "Adobe Twirl", parameter key angle: <LiveEffect name="Adobe Twirl"><Dict data="R angle 0.0 "/></LiveEffect>. (Not to be confused with Effect > Warp > Twist, which is Adobe Deform with DeformStyle 15.)
answers.warp-flag-style: DeformStyle 8 (I DeformStyle 8) selects Flag: <LiveEffect name="Adobe Deform"><Dict data="R DeformHoriz 0.0 I DeformStyle 8 R DeformValue 0.5 R DeformVert 0.0 B Rotate 0 "/></LiveEffect>
answers.roughen-detail-key: dtal (R dtal 10.0). Other keys: asiz, size, absoluteness, roundness.
answers.offset-path-effect-keys: ofst = offset distance (R ofst 10.0), jntp = join type (I jntp 2), mlim = miter limit (R mlim 4.0). LiveEffect "Adobe Offset Path".
answers.rasterize-effect-dpi-key: "dpi." (four characters including the trailing period): I dpi. 72. Other keys: padd, alis, colr, mask, optn.
answers.outline-object-effect-name: "Adobe Outline Type" (empty Dict: <LiveEffect name="Adobe Outline Type"><Dict data=" "/></LiveEffect>).
answers.point-area-route: executeMenuCommand('point-area') is refused by Illustrator for scripts: it throws PARM. The DOM equivalent is textFrame.convertPointObjectToAreaObject() (verified by readback).
answers.type-on-path-route: Through the real menu bar with tools/menu_ui.py, which reads the native popup menus and clicks 文字 > 路徑文字 > 偏斜效果 (Type > Type on a Path > Skew); verified by pixels.
answers.rotate-view-route: document.activeView.rotateAngle = 90 (the menu itself also needs GPU Preview).
answers.unverified-member-count: 250 unverified (193 properties + 57 methods) and 684 COM-only (575 properties + 109 methods), out of 2715 members (1781 verified in ExtendScript).
answers.same-call-selection: Illustrator refreshes command targets only when idle, so a menu command issued in the same run_js call that created/selected the objects acts on the old selection or silently does nothing. Fix: select in one run_js call and run app.executeMenuCommand() in the next call (give it an idle moment, ~0.6 s, between calls), and look items up again at the start of each call since references go stale; verify with FP()/FPDIFF().
